name: components-community-flip-card
title: Flip Card
description: A dark profile card shows an avatar, a name and a handle; turning it over reveals a short bio, three follower counts, social icons and a follow button.
use: A small profile or team card needs a second layer of details without opening a dialog.
avoid: Hover-triggered flip is awkward on touch, and the back is unreachable by keyboard or screen reader.
a11y: The flip is hover-only on desktop and the card is not focusable, so keyboard and screen-reader users never reach the back. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A tall, rounded card with a thin translucent border on a near-black stage. The front is centred on a round avatar, a bold name and a grey handle. The back stacks a small bio paragraph, three large numbers with captions, a row of three icons and a small white button.
behaves: Hovering the card turns it 180 degrees around its vertical axis, and it turns back when the pointer leaves; on a touch screen a tap toggles it. The half-second flip swaps the profile face for the detail face.
customise: All copy, avatar, stats and social links come from one data object; the fixed size, colours and half-second flip need a source edit.
weight: light: Two card faces and one transform animation; nothing runs at rest.
demo: Alex Rivera, @alexrivera, an avatar, a short bio, 312 following, 4800 followers and 127 posts.
issues: Frame 3 catches the card squashed mid-flip, so it is not usable as a still.
Bio and captions are small grey text with low contrast on the dark card.
polishWhy: Crisp card faces and a smooth flip; small grey text sits low contrast on near-black.
